caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a cradleboard resting on a flat surface. The cradleboard is oval-shaped and decorated with geometric patterns, including green, blue, and red triangular and rectangular shapes on a pale beige background. Draped over the cradleboard is a piece of cloth that is off-white or light beige in color, featuring a scalloped red trim along one edge. The lines are carefully rendered, giving texture to the cloth, and subtle shading is used to suggest folds and form. The overall composition centers the cradleboard and cloth against a plain background, with the image set within the bounds of a simple rectangular frame.
title: Beaded Moccasin
